title: Correct deviation expression
description: Essential: The student's final expression for δθ must be equivalent to δθ = arctan(((K_s - K_b) sinθ cosθ) / (1 - K_b cos²θ - K_s sin²θ)).

title: Maximum deviation headings
description: Essential: The student must identify the headings where δθ is largest as θ = 45°, 135°, 225°, and 315° (or equivalent radian measures).

title: Iron ball field expression
description: Important: The student must derive the radial component of the iron ball's magnetic field as B_r = 2 B_e (m K_i / d³) cos φ, showing the dipole field structure.

title: Corrected deviation result
description: Essential: For part (4), the student must conclude that the combined deviation after correction is zero (δθ = 0).

title: Superposition of components
description: Important: The solution must correctly sum the northward (B_e) and eastward (ship's field) components to find the total field direction.

title: Small-angle approximation
description: Important: For part (2), the student must apply the small K_b, K_s approximation to simplify tan(δθ) ≈ (K_s - K_b) sinθ cosθ.

title: Trigonometric maximization
description: Important: The student must recognize that maximizing δθ involves maximizing sin(2θ) or sinθ cosθ under the small-angle approximation.

title: Sign or coordinate error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student confuses the signs of the ship's field components (B_s) or misaligns the unit vectors (b̂, ŝ) with north/east.

title: Unit or factor mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize errors in the dipole field derivation, such as missing the factor of 2 in the radial component or incorrect distance dependence (1/d³).
